decisionsTitle: «Email respins» says which email, when and why (amending §650, §76/§83)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-04**, on the registrations list filtered by «Doar cine nu a primit emailul», showing rows «Confirmată» with the chip «Email respins»: «Cum e asta corect tehnic? Cum poți să nu fi primit mail dar să fii și confirmat? Adaugă tooltips și informații».

**Why both are true.** The chip never meant «the confirmation email did not arrive». It means that the NEWEST email the site sent to this registration was rejected — `BOUNCED` (the address does not exist, the mailbox is full, the recipient's server refused it) or `COMPLAINED` (the person marked it as spam), `AGENTS.md` §16.5 — any of the message types, a club copy excepted (§320). That email can come long after the address was confirmed: the link was clicked (or the address was vouched for by staff, or on paper at the desk), the place was confirmed, and a later message — the race number, a reminder, an announcement — bounced. «Confirmată» with «Email respins» is therefore a confirmed participant the club can no longer reach by email: exactly the person to phone before the race. The data was right; the words around it said the opposite.

**Decision: words and information, no behaviour change.**

- **The data.** The list's, the page's and the desk's subquery (`admin-repository.ts`, `emailRejected`) returns one object — `{ messageType, at, status, reason }` — in place of the reason alone: the same newest bounced or complained row, a club copy excluded, the same filter (`bounced=1`) and the same export column. `at` is when the message left (`sent_at`), or when it was queued when the provider refused it at the send and it never had a `sent_at`; no rejection instant is stored and none is added (no migration). The desk's query also reads `email_confirmed_at`. The reason stays the provider's short sanitized text (§16.1).
- **The words**, one pure function (`registrations/ui/rejected-email-words.ts`, `rejectedEmailWords`), in the reader's language: which email — its name in «Setări» → «Emailuri» (`Admin.emails.types`), «un email al clubului» for a type the catalogue does not name —, when, in club time and §452's inline form («Respins: „Numărul de concurs dat de mână”, trimis {instant}.», the instant with its weekday and «la» before the hour); why, in plain words (bounce: «Adresa nu există, căsuța e plină sau serverul destinatarului l-a refuzat.»; complaint: «Mesajul a fost marcat ca spam de destinatar.»); the context — «Adresa a fost confirmată {date}; un email trimis după aceea a fost respins.» when the address was confirmed before the rejected email, «Adresa a fost confirmată {date}, după acest email.» when after, «Adresa nu a fost confirmată niciodată.» when never — with no «pe» before the weekday (§452); and what to do: «Sună persoana; adresa o poate schimba doar ea, printr-o înscriere nouă.» The provider's reason comes apart, in small print («Motivul dat de furnizor: …»).
- **The chip** («Email respins», unchanged) is a client island, `EmailRejectedChip`, with an MUI `Tooltip` that opens on hover, on keyboard focus and on a tap (`describeChild`, a 44-pixel focusable target whose accessible name carries the sentences), replacing the `title` attribute that carried the provider's raw error and never showed on a phone. The same island on the list's row, on the registration's page beside the name and on the desk row (which still shows no address, §67).
- **The registration's page** says the same sentences in full on a line under the address, the reason in small print beneath.
- **«Ce îi spui» (§654)** adds one sentence, in the registration's language, when the newest email was rejected — on any state, confirmed included: «Ultimul email trimis la adresa ta a fost respins: adresa nu există sau căsuța e plină, așa că mesajele clubului nu ajung la tine.» or, for a complaint, «… a fost marcat ca spam, așa că mesajele clubului s-ar putea să nu mai ajungă la tine.» No address in it.
- **The filter** is renamed «Doar cu un email respins» / “Only with a rejected email” (same `bounced=1`), and its help says it in two sentences: those whose latest email bounced or was marked as spam, even when the registration is confirmed; the row's «Email respins» says which email, when and why — these are the people to call.

This amends §650 (the filter's name and help, the chip's hover text) and §76/§83 (what the chip reads). The guide («Ghid») does not name «Email respins» and is unchanged.

**Refused.**

- **Editing the address for the person.** The address is the registration's identity (§67, `AGENTS.md` §10.4, §15.11) and stays the person's (§645): the words tell staff to phone, and that only the person can change it, by registering again.
- **A second chip for «confirmed, then rejected».** One chip, and its tooltip says whether the address was confirmed before the rejection; two chips for one fact is a chip nobody reads.
- **Hiding the chip on confirmed rows.** A confirmed participant the email no longer reaches is precisely whom the club must know about before race day.
- **Storing a rejection instant** (a column, a migration) for a sharper «when»: the instant the message left, or was queued, answers the question the screen asks.

**Consequences.** `registrations/admin-repository.ts` (`emailRejected` in place of `emailRejectedReason` on the list, the page and the desk rows; `emailConfirmedAt` on the desk row); `registrations/domain/rejected-email.ts`, `registrations/ui/rejected-email-words.ts` and `registrations/ui/EmailRejectedChip.tsx` (new); `ui/tell-words.ts`; `ui/DeskRow.tsx`; the list page and the registration's page; the export route reads `emailRejected`; `messages/{ro,en}.json` (`Admin.registrations.rejected.*`, `tell.rejected.*`, the filter's label and help). No migration, no dependency, no change to the allocator, the emails, the export's columns or a public page; the public participant list is untouched. Tests: unit `registrations/rejected-email-words.test.ts` (bounce and complaint, confirmed before, after and never, an unknown type, the «Ce îi spui» line, every string under 200 characters, the subquery's object read parsed and as text), integration `registrations/email-rejected-screens.test.ts` (the list: a confirmed row whose race-number email bounced, a never-confirmed row whose address email bounced, a complaint, the newest rejection winning; the page's chip, the line under the address and «Ce îi spui»; the desk's chip with no address), and the adapted `registrations/member-tick-screens.test.ts`, `notifications/club-copy.test.ts` and e2e `promo-filter.spec.ts` (the filter's new name).
changelogLine: - **«Email respins» says which email, when and why** — the chip on the registrations list, the registration's page and the desk opens a tooltip naming the rejected email, when it left, whether it bounced or was marked as spam, whether the address had been confirmed before it, and that the person should be phoned; the filter is now «Doar cu un email respins», and «Ce îi spui» says the email no longer reaches the person. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a registration whose newest email (a club copy excepted) was bounced or marked as spam, when the registrations list, the registration's page or the desk row renders, then «Email respins» opens on hover, keyboard focus and a tap a tooltip that names the email by its «Emailuri» name, the instant it left in club time, why in plain words (the address does not exist or the mailbox is full; or marked as spam), whether the address had been confirmed before it, after it or never, and that the person is to be phoned — the provider's reason in small print, never a `title` attribute; the registration's page says the same under the address, and the desk shows no address (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list, when its filter row renders, then the `bounced=1` tick reads «Doar cu un email respins» / “Only with a rejected email”, its help saying that it can happen after the confirmation and that the row's «Email respins» says which email, when and why; no screen offers staff a way to change the address, and the words say only the person can, by registering again (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration whose newest email was bounced or marked as spam, when «Ce îi spui» renders, then it ends with one sentence in the registration's language saying the last email to the person's address was rejected (or marked as spam) and the club's messages do not reach them, on any state, confirmed included, with no address (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Email respins» says which email, when and why
